## Research Handoff / 科研交接包

**English:** Paste the complete contents of `research-handoff.md` below, or attach the `.md` file using GitHub's attachment feature (drag and drop or select a file).

**中文：** 在下方粘贴完整的 `research-handoff.md` 内容，或通过 GitHub 附件功能拖入、选择并上传 `.md` 文件。

[Research dialogue prompt & evidence requirements / 科研指令与证据要求](https://github.com/ZWY-research/Fusion-Research-Atlas/blob/main/docs/workflows/research-dialogue-prompt.md)

**Public submission / 公开提交：** Submit only material you are permitted to share publicly. Do not upload copyrighted full papers without permission, restricted research data, or confidential information. / 仅提交允许公开分享的材料，不上传未经授权的论文全文、受限科研数据或保密资料。

**Status / 状态：** A submitted Issue is a candidate scientific contribution, not an independently verified finding. / Issue 投稿属于候选科研贡献，不代表科学结论已经独立验证。
